主要内容: The article highlights how many of the world's popular clothing brands are produced by lesser-known South Korean companies. Hansae Co., Sae-A Trading Co., and Youngone Corp. are among the few Asian firms that have dominated the global apparel industry for years. These companies have been manufacturing clothes for well-known brands like Zara, Abercrombie & Fitch, Nike, and Patagonia. Initially, they produced garments in South Korea during the 1980s, but as labor costs increased, they moved their factories to China and other developing countries. After three decades of producing for others, these companies now aim to establish their own brands.
